notes.content:
Fixed an armor display bug: When creating the armor update, the code that swaps armor appearances was entirely rewritten. This adjusted the priority number that is assigned to each armor. Old saves after the armor update may not have been able to change their armor appearance. This has since been corrected.

Thank you for your time playing my game. It has been extremely encouraging and makes me wish to make more.

notes.title: 1.1 The Armor Update
notes.content:
While working to improve some minor aspects of the game, I decided we had to bring on-board some new armors. There are four in total, with the frost armor shown below. These require the hidden crafting recipe list from the igloo, so if you haven't gotten it yet, what are you waiting for?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45454908/b890687fc66c0dc54c4a52e85660c8d507d543b4.png[/img]

[b]The changes are as follows[/b]:
1. Four new armors were added, including the Frost, Fire, Tentacle and Diamond armors.
2. Four images have been adjusted in the game to better reflect the scene they take place in. Most of these were during interactions with Lina. Always available to review in the memory hall if you're curious!
3. A new zone has been added with a new NSFW scene. 

Thank you again for all the time you have spent playing this game. If any bugs occur, please let me know in the pinned comment and I will review them ASAP. As always, have fun gaming!

notes.title: 1.02 - The Undress Patch
notes.content:
A player asked a question, and I couldn't bring myself to justify not adding this to the game. When you start a new file, you will find an extra item in the equipment labeled "Naked". This item does what it sounds and removes the clothing from Erzia on the right. 

-Minor bug fix:
Corrected a glitch in the Frozen Forest. There was a secret here that would fail to load an image after multiple interactions. This little Easter egg has been reworked, and the image has been properly included.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
The update corrects a bug which stops leveling in certain dungeons if you choose to look around more as opposed to leave immediately. 

Thank you so much for the kind words I have received thus far. If anything else comes to light, please let me know and I will address it as soon as possible!
